### Compounded Semaglutide (Telehealth) (Semaglutide + B12 (Cyanocobalamin))
- **Page URL**: https://lacallela.github.io/us-pharmacy/drugs/compounded-semaglutide
- **Drug Classification**: Telehealth (Weight Loss & GLP-1)
- **Manufacturer**: FDA-Regulated 503A/503B Compounder
- **Standard Dosage**: Monthly Supply (Tailored Dose) (Subcutaneous Injectable Vial)
- **Brand Price**: $948.00
- **Generic Cash Price**: $199.00 (Save 79%)
- **FDA Indications**: Chronic weight management in adults with BMI >= 30, or BMI >= 27 with at least one weight-related comorbid condition.
- **Contraindications**: Pregnancy, history of pancreatitis, thyroid cancer risk.
- **How to Use**: Inject weekly with sterile micro-needle as prescribed by your online physician.
- **Side Effects**: Mild transient nausea.
- **Clinical Overview**: Affordable compounded semaglutide formulated by licensed US 503A/503B state-board pharmacies through telehealth platforms (Ro, Hims). Includes physician consult and home delivery.

### Ozempic (Brand Pen) (Semaglutide Injection)
- **Page URL**: https://lacallela.github.io/us-pharmacy/drugs/ozempic
- **Drug Classification**: Rx (Weight Loss & GLP-1)
- **Manufacturer**: Novo Nordisk
- **Standard Dosage**: 2mg/3mL (0.5mg or 1mg weekly dose) (Prefilled Subcutaneous Pen)
- **Brand Price**: $948.00
- **Generic Cash Price**: $299.00 (Save 68%)
- **FDA Indications**: Type 2 Diabetes mellitus; off-label for chronic weight management and obesity.
- **Contraindications**: Personal or family history of medullary thyroid carcinoma (MTC) or Multiple Endocrine Neoplasia syndrome type 2 (MEN 2).
- **How to Use**: Inject subcutaneously once weekly in abdomen, thigh, or upper arm on the same day each week.
- **Side Effects**: Nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal discomfort, constipation (especially when escalating dose).
- **Clinical Overview**: A weekly GLP-1 receptor agonist that slows stomach emptying, reduces hunger cravings, and significantly regulates blood sugar levels.

### Atorvastatin (Generic Lipitor) (Atorvastatin Calcium)
- **Page URL**: https://lacallela.github.io/us-pharmacy/drugs/atorvastatin
- **Drug Classification**: Rx (Cholesterol & Heart)
- **Manufacturer**: Teva / Sandoz Generics
- **Standard Dosage**: 20mg, 30 tablets (Oral Tablet)
- **Brand Price**: $185.00
- **Generic Cash Price**: $7.20 (Save 96%)
- **FDA Indications**: Primary hyperlipidemia, cardiovascular risk reduction in adults.
- **Contraindications**: Severe hepatic impairment, pregnancy, hypersensitivity to atorvastatin.
- **How to Use**: Take 1 tablet daily. Routine lipid panel tests recommended every 6 to 12 months.
- **Side Effects**: Occasional mild muscle soreness.
- **Clinical Overview**: Direct FDA-approved generic equivalent of Lipitor. Contains identical active ingredient, potency, bioequivalence, and safety profile at 96% lower retail cost.

### Viagra (Sildenafil Citrate)
- **Page URL**: https://lacallela.github.io/us-pharmacy/drugs/viagra
- **Drug Classification**: Rx (Erectile Dysfunction)
- **Manufacturer**: Pfizer / Generic Labs
- **Standard Dosage**: 100mg, 30 tablets (Film-coated Tablets)
- **Brand Price**: $780.00
- **Generic Cash Price**: $18.50 (Save 98%)
- **FDA Indications**: Treatment of erectile dysfunction (ED) in adult males; pulmonary arterial hypertension.
- **Contraindications**: Do not take with nitrates (nitroglycerin) or guanylate cyclase stimulators due to risk of fatal blood pressure drop. Avoid in severe cardiac conditions.
- **How to Use**: Take 1 tablet orally with water 30 to 60 minutes before anticipated sexual activity. Do not exceed 1 dose per 24 hours.
- **Side Effects**: Headache, facial flushing, nasal congestion, indigestion, mild visual hue alterations.
- **Clinical Overview**: Viagra (sildenafil) is the world-renowned PDE-5 inhibitor designed to treat erectile dysfunction by relaxing blood vessels in the penis, facilitating firm and sustained erections when sexually stimulated.

### Synthroid (Levothyroxine Sodium)

- **Drug Classification**: Rx (Thyroid & Hormone)
- **Manufacturer**: AbbVie / Generic Labs
- **Standard Dosage**: 100mcg (0.1mg), 30 tablets (Tablets)
- **Brand Price**: $68.00
- **Generic Cash Price**: $11.20 (Save 84%)
- **FDA Indications**: Hypothyroidism; pituitary TSH suppression.
- **Contraindications**: Uncorrected adrenal insufficiency.
- **How to Use**: Take as a single daily dose on an empty stomach with a full glass of water, 30 to 60 minutes before breakfast.
- **Side Effects**: Rare when properly dosed (signs of excess: palpitations, sweating, nervousness).
- **Clinical Overview**: Synthroid (levothyroxine) is synthetic T4 thyroid hormone identical to that produced by the human thyroid gland, restoring optimal energy and metabolic rate.

- **Manufacturer**: Janssen / Generic Labs
- **Standard Dosage**: 50mg, 30 tablets (Coated Tablets)
- **Brand Price**: $145.00
- **Generic Cash Price**: $15.00 (Save 90%)
- **FDA Indications**: Prophylaxis of migraine in patients 12 years of age and older; initial monotherapy for seizures.
- **Contraindications**: Recent alcohol use with extended release; metabolic acidosis history.

- **Side Effects**: Paresthesia (tingling in fingers/toes), taste perversion, fatigue, weight loss.
- **Clinical Overview**: Topamax (topiramate) is an anticonvulsant and FDA-approved migraine preventative that stabilizes hyperactive neuronal channels to reduce headache frequency.

- **Brand Price**: $125.00
- **Generic Cash Price**: $18.50 (Save 85%)
- **FDA Indications**: Lower respiratory tract infections, acute bacterial otitis media, sinusitis, skin and soft tissue infections.
- **Contraindications**: History of Augmentin-associated hepatic dysfunction, penicillin hypersensitivity.

- **Standard Dosage**: 5% topical solution, 60ml bottle (Topical Solution)
- **Brand Price**: $45.00
- **Generic Cash Price**: $14.00 (Save 69%)
- **FDA Indications**: Regrow hair on top of the scalp (vertex only) in men with androgenetic alopecia.
- **Contraindications**: Scalp irritation, sunburn, open lesions, sudden or patchy hair loss.
- **How to Use**: Apply 1 mL directly to the scalp in the hair loss area twice daily.
- **Side Effects**: Local scalp stinging, redness, unwanted facial hair if dripped.
- **Clinical Overview**: Rogaine (minoxidil 5%) directly revitalizes shrunken hair follicles, increases local scalp circulation, and stimulates new thicker hair regrowth.

### Arimidex (Anastrozole)
- **Page URL**: https://lacallela.github.io/us-pharmacy/drugs/arimidex
- **Drug Classification**: Rx (Women's Health)
- **Manufacturer**: AstraZeneca / Generic Labs
- **Standard Dosage**: 1mg, 30 tablets (Tablets)
- **Brand Price**: $240.00
- **Generic Cash Price**: $18.50 (Save 92%)
- **FDA Indications**: Adjuvant treatment of postmenopausal women with hormone receptor-positive early breast cancer.
- **Contraindications**: Women of premenopausal status, pregnancy.
- **How to Use**: Take 1 tablet once daily with or without food.
- **Side Effects**: Hot flashes, asthenia, arthritis, joint pain, osteoporosis risk.
- **Clinical Overview**: Arimidex (anastrozole) is a potent non-steroidal aromatase inhibitor that lowers circulating estrogen levels by over 80% in postmenopausal women.

### Prilosec OTC (Brand) (Omeprazole Delayed-Release)
- **Page URL**: https://lacallela.github.io/us-pharmacy/drugs/prilosec-otc
- **Drug Classification**: OTC (Acid Reflux & GERD)
- **Manufacturer**: Procter & Gamble
- **Standard Dosage**: 20mg, 42 tablets (3x 14-day courses) (Delayed-Release Tablet)
- **Brand Price**: $27.50
- **Generic Cash Price**: $9.90 (Save 64%)
- **FDA Indications**: Frequent heartburn occurring 2 or more days a week.
- **Contraindications**: Trouble or pain swallowing food, vomiting with blood, or bloody/black stools (see doctor immediately).
- **How to Use**: Take 1 tablet every morning before eating for 14 days. Do not chew or crush.
- **Side Effects**: Headache, stomach pain, diarrhea.
- **Clinical Overview**: Proton pump inhibitor (PPI) that shuts down excess stomach acid pumps at the source for round-the-clock 24-hour relief from painful heartburn.

### Advil Liqui-Gels (Brand) (Ibuprofen Solubilized)
- **Page URL**: https://lacallela.github.io/us-pharmacy/drugs/advil
- **Drug Classification**: OTC (Pain & Inflammation)
- **Manufacturer**: Haleon US
- **Standard Dosage**: 200mg, 80 capsules (Liquid Filled Capsule)
- **Brand Price**: $15.99
- **Generic Cash Price**: $4.49 (Save 72%)
- **FDA Indications**: Temporary relief of minor aches, pains, headaches, and fever reduction.
- **Contraindications**: Active stomach ulcers, bleeding disorders, severe heart disease, or during third trimester of pregnancy.
- **How to Use**: Adults: take 1 to 2 capsules every 4 to 6 hours while symptoms persist. Do not exceed 6 capsules in 24 hours.
- **Side Effects**: Mild stomach upset (take with food or milk to minimize).
- **Clinical Overview**: Nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID) designed to target the site of inflammation and rapidly block pain signals.
